name: dopamine-changelog
description: Writes and rewrites changelogs, mod updates, and GitHub release notes so they spark genuine excitement, sell the real power of a release, and read cleanly in one breath. Translates raw git diffs, optimizations, and dependency upgrades into the user-impact derivative f'(x): vivid before/after storytelling, domain-native impact contrasts (FPS, freezes, RAM, latency, queries, build time, cost, or tokens), and exact CVE/version clarity. Works for any software: games, Minecraft mods, web/mobile apps, desktop tools, libraries, or AI agents. Triggers: "dopamine-changelog", "changelog", "release notes", "release highlights", "summarize release".
